title: LF party to build a webgl casual chill social game
author: RossPeili
selftext:
with emphasis on pastel aesthetic, cosmetics, mini interactive games and apps, monster gathering and breeding, cooking, chess, fishing, house building, seasonal events and more.

Looking for gamers at heart who are playing since the 90s+, AI native, and who understand at least the basics of software engineebest practices, have shipped in production, or have a portfolio.

I bring all the above too, so trying to find someone who will genuinely like this and want to build it into production, not as a hobby or once in a month discord call.

I have the core mechanics, weather system, inventory system, pets, and more. Need better world design, multilayer layer and server and more social features.

Thanks.
